### Features

******

Enable or improve code completion in development tools:

* CeenJs6: [current releases](https://github.com/suminwell/CeenJs6/releases). The complete declarations retain newer APIs; read the [compatibility notes](https://github.com/suminwell/CeenJs6-TypeScript-Declarations/blob/ceen/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) before using them.
* Supported development tools: [VSCode](https://code.visualstudio.com/download) / [WebStorm](https://www.jetbrains.com/webstorm/download/) / [HBuilderX](https://www.dcloud.io/hbuilderx.html) ...

******

### Examples

******

```javascript
console.log(ceenjs.versionName);
console.log(ceenjs.packageName); // org.ceenjs.ceenjs6
const host = app.ceenjs;
```

### Usage

******

#### [ 1 ] - Obtain the declarations (d.ts) directory

Get the directory from NPM or GitHub.

##### Get it from NPM (recommended)

```shell
npm i ceenjs6
```

After installation, locate `/node_modules/ceenjs6/declarations`.

##### Get it from GitHub

[Download the latest project zip archive](https://github.com/suminwell/CeenJs6-TypeScript-Declarations/archive/refs/heads/ceen.zip) and extract the `declarations` directory.

#### [ 2 ] - Place the declarations directory

> Skip this step when using WebStorm.

Place the directory anywhere inside your project.

For a project named `hello`, suppose the directory structure is:

> hello / images / ...
> hello / docs / ...
> hello / main.js
> hello / project.json
> ... ...

The `declarations` directory can then be placed as follows:

> hello / declarations / (recommended)
> hello / images / declarations /
> hello / docs / declarations /
> hello / ... / ... / declarations /

It cannot be placed alongside the project or in a parent directory.

#### [ 3 ] - Enable or improve code completion

The development tool automatically discovers and indexes all declaration files.

After indexing, start coding with completion suggestions.

> Note: some editors need to restart before indexing declarations.

#### [ 4 ] - Additional configuration for VSCode

Unlike WebStorm, VSCode may not recognize the declarations directory in every location. In particular, a declarations directory deployed with npm may not be discovered by VSCode by default. Copy [jsconfig.json](https://github.com/suminwell/CeenJs6-TypeScript-Declarations/blob/ceen/jsconfig.json) into the project root, for example:

> hello / node_modules / ceenjs6 / ...
> hello / jsconfig.json
> hello / main.js
> ... ...

If the project already has jsconfig.json, merge the following configuration into it:

```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2020",
    "lib": ["ES2020"],
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "types": ["ceenjs6"],
    "typeRoots": [
      "./node_modules/ceenjs6/declarations",
      "./declarations"
    ]
  },
  "exclude": [
    "node_modules",
    "**/cj6-jsox-extensions.d.ts",
    "**/cj6-jsox-*-extensions.d.ts"
  ]
}
```

Restart VSCode to enable or improve code completion for `hello/main.js` in this example.

#### Optional JSOX extensions

Reference the following entry only when the script enables JSOX at runtime. index.d.ts does not load these declarations by default. If an editor scans every local declaration file, exclude cj6-jsox-*-extensions.d.ts by default, then explicitly reference the selected entry.

```typescript
/// <reference path="./declarations/ceenjs6/cj6-jsox-extensions.d.ts" />
jsox.extendAll();
const values = [1, 2, 2].distinct();
const parsed = Number.parseFloat('ff', 16);
```

For one module, choose cj6-jsox-array-extensions.d.ts, cj6-jsox-number-extensions.d.ts or cj6-jsox-math-extensions.d.ts and call the matching jsox.extend. Third-party declarations cover common bundled core APIs. Optional Dayjs plugins need their own declarations; incomplete Axios browser adapters are not presented as complete browser APIs.

******

### Updates

******

Get updates directly from NPM:

```shell
npm update ceenjs6
```

To check for updates, visit the [project homepage](https://github.com/suminwell/CeenJs6-TypeScript-Declarations), or open package.json at the project root and hover over the version of the ceenjs6 dependency to see available updates. VSCode can also use [Version Lens](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=pflannery.vscode-versionlens) to check for updates.

The declarations are usually updated alongside new releases of [CeenJs6](https://github.com/suminwell/CeenJs6).

## Changelog

### v5.0.0

###### 2026/10/19

##### First CeenJs6 adaptation

* `Feature` Migrate declaration paths, ceenjs/$ceenjs/app.ceenjs, Java packages, resources and TSX names; rename the npm package to ceenjs6
* `Hint` Retain the complete newer API surface and document host/plugin requirements for the current CeenJs6 6.7.0 runtime; fix opt-in JSOX loading
* `Improvement` Add type/documentation checks, verifiable npm/ZIP artifacts, automatic GitHub Releases and optional npm publishing

### v4.42.0

###### 2026/10/16

* `Feature` preview, presets, importPresets and their asynchronous forms, deleteHistory and clearHistory of files.batchRename, the pinyin, photo metadata and preset options and metadataMissing of plan items, covering name previews, named presets, metadata variables, Chinese to pinyin and history cleanup of the Batch Rename plugin
* `Hint` Requires matching host 6.8.0 and the Batch Rename plugin 1.1.0

### v4.41.0

###### 2026/10/16

* `Feature` plugins.tools with its tool, provider, call option and result types, covering the tools AutoJs6 plugins describe themselves: listing, synchronous and asynchronous calls, image / file / directory arguments and output files
* `Hint` Requires matching host 6.8.0 and a plugin that provides tools

[Full changelog](https://github.com/suminwell/CeenJs6-TypeScript-Declarations/blob/ceen/.changelog/CHANGELOG-en.md)
